digestNormalization.rationale: contractDigest excluded to avoid self-referential recursion; planRevision excluded because the canonical Decision binds plan_revision at record time — the adoption writer stamps both fields AFTER digest computation; the read-only checker re-computes with this identical normalization and compares against the canonical decision payload

behaviors: A: evaluator validates presence, JSON, project/run/phase identity, latest non-superseded adoption digest, source freshness and per-scenario oracles BEFORE any ALREADY-CLOSED; the closure match is bound to phase + run + adopted contract digest, so a different run or a superseded contract cannot inherit a same-phase historical PASS; unchanged valid bound replay stays idempotent

B: evaluator budget predicate compares declared ceilings (contract budgets + additive extensions; latest extension resultingCeilings wins) against evidence budgetConsumption, which identifies its source and classes each value measured/estimate/unknown; consumption ABOVE a ceiling refuses closure (BLOCKED); consumption AT a ceiling permits closure of work completed within limits and records exhaustion (no further work admitted); unknown-class values are not enforced (declared time/tool fallback governs)
amendments.proofLimits: budgetConsumption is self-reported run accounting (agent-authored or fixture-supplied), NOT independent telemetry and NOT tamper-proof; the predicate proves only the declared-limit comparison and refusal behavior; a missing header skips the predicate and is disclosed as budget-consumption-undeclared in the closure record
